## What is the problem?

Describe what you are trying to do and where Repo Frame gets in the way.

## What would you like instead?

Describe the behaviour you want. If it affects the editor, say which panel or
control it belongs to.

## Alternatives you considered

Describe anything you tried, or other ways the problem could be solved.

## Additional context

Add screenshots or links. If you are proposing a new card layout, open a
template request instead.
